outlook: Prices below are still Wednesday's closes: US grain markets were shut for Thanksgiving and reopen this morning at 8:30 am CT for a short session that ends around noon. Corn and soybeans rallied into Wednesday on fund short covering, a weaker dollar and continued Chinese soybean buying, with December corn at $4.39¾ and January soybeans at $12.44. Chicago wheat slipped on December liquidation and slow exports, while Minneapolis December spring wheat gained 4¾ cents to $6.41½ and ICE January canola eased C$1.90 to C$771.30. Light holiday volume is expected today as traders roll out of December contracts ahead of Monday's first notice day.
